+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+annual = duckdb.sql("""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_motorist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths,
+           MIN(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           MAX(crash_date) AS last_date
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+""").df()
+assert annual["year"].tolist() == list(range(2013, 2026))
+assert all(d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") == f"{y}-01-01" for y, d in zip(annual.year, annual.first_date))
+assert all(d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") == f"{y}-12-31" for y, d in zip(annual.year, annual.last_date))
+years = annual["year"].to_numpy()
+motorists = annual["motorist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+cyclists = annual["cyclist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+colors = {"Motorists": "#3366a6", "Cyclists": "#e07a32"}
+
+# Option 1: absolute annual counts, grouped by road-user type.
+long_counts = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].melt(
+    id_vars="year", var_name="victim_type", value_name="deaths"
+)
+long_counts["victim_type"] = long_counts["victim_type"].map(
+    {"motorist_deaths": "Motorists", "cyclist_deaths": "Cyclists"}
+)
+long_counts.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.7))
+x = np.arange(len(years))
+w = 0.38
+ax.bar(x - w / 2, motorists, width=w, color=colors["Motorists"], label="Motorists")
+ax.bar(x + w / 2, cyclists, width=w, color=colors["Cyclists"], label="Cyclists")
+ax.set_xticks(x, years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Reported deaths")
+ax.set_title("Annual motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025")
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="upper right")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: motorist-to-cyclist count ratio each year.
+ratio = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].copy()
+ratio["motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"] = ratio.motorist_deaths / ratio.cyclist_deaths
+ratio.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.7))
+ax.plot(years, ratio.motorist_to_cyclist_ratio, color="#5b4b8a", marker="o", linewidth=2.2)
+ax.axhline(1, color="#777777", linewidth=1, linestyle="--", label="Equal counts (1:1)")
+ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Motorist deaths ÷ cyclist deaths")
+ax.set_title("Motorist deaths relative to cyclist deaths by year")
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: 100% stacked proportions, where denominator is the two groups combined.
+share = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].copy()
+share["combined_deaths"] = share.motorist_deaths + share.cyclist_deaths
+share["motorist_share_percent"] = 100 * share.motorist_deaths / share.combined_deaths
+share["cyclist_share_percent"] = 100 * share.cyclist_deaths / share.combined_deaths
+share.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.7))
+ax.bar(years, share.motorist_share_percent, color=colors["Motorists"], label="Motorists")
+ax.bar(years, share.cyclist_share_percent, bottom=share.motorist_share_percent,
+       color=colors["Cyclists"], label="Cyclists")
+ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
+ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Share of motorist + cyclist deaths (%)")
+ax.set_title("Share of combined motorist and cyclist deaths by year")
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.01))
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(annual[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].to_string(index=False))
+print("\n2025 ratio:", ratio.loc[ratio.year == 2025, "motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"].iloc[0])
+print("\nMax ratio:", ratio.loc[ratio.motorist_to_cyclist_ratio.idxmax()].to_dict())
+print("\nCyclist share highest:", share.loc[share.cyclist_share_percent.idxmax()].to_dict())

+

+annual = duckdb.sql("""

+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_motorist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths,
+           MIN(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           MAX(crash_date) AS last_date
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'

+    GROUP BY year

+motorists = annual["motorist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+cyclists = annual["cyclist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+colors = {"Motorists": "#3366a6", "Cyclists": "#e07a32"}
+
+# Option 1: absolute annual counts, grouped by road-user type.
+long_counts = annual[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].melt(
+    id_vars="year", var_name="victim_type", value_name="deaths"
+)
+long_counts["victim_type"] = long_counts["victim_type"].map(

+)

+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="upper right")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)

+
